kept_title: Scheduler crashes when DAG has zero tasks
duplicate_title: NullPointerException in scheduler with empty DAG
similarity_summary: Both issues report an AttributeError raised by the scheduler when processing a DAG that contains zero tasks. The root cause is identical: dag.task_count assumes at least one task is present and raises AttributeError on an empty DAG.
